title.zh: Shadowrocket HTTPS 解密与脚本（Script）扩展：证书安装与去视频广告实战
title.en: Shadowrocket HTTPS Decryption & Scripting: CA Certificate Trust & In-App Ad Elimination

description.zh: 详解 iOS Shadowrocket 的中间人攻击（MitM）解密与 JavaScript 脚本重写功能。教你如何安全生成本地 CA 根证书、在 iOS 系统设置中完成完全信任、拦截视频开屏广告并实现自动化任务签到。
description.en: Master HTTPS decryption (MitM) and JavaScript script rewrites in iOS Shadowrocket. Step-by-step instructions for generating local CA root certificates, enabling full SSL trust in iOS settings, and stripping telemetry trackers.
